alias.notes: All raw themes mapped to existing canonical names, with semantic grouping of variants like 'Enterprise AI Platform' and '企业数据上的应用LLM' to 'LLM/生成式AI应用'; 'AI系统可观测性' and 'Token/成本可观测' to 'AI系统可观测性/成本'; 'Prompt injection/AI安全' to 'AI安全/Responsible AI'; and AI编码agent variants to 'AI编码agent当硬技能'.
